integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite standard-library diagnostics are corroboration and not certification of asymptotic statements. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to frozen-feedback deterministic well-mixed competing contagion with equal committed fractions and reciprocal exponents; excludes time-varying crisis feedback, heterogeneous networks, and finite stochastic sampling.
title: Universal attraction and a singular zealot–feedback crossover in competing contagion
